boundaries.memory: Agents may read scoped context; persistence requires ASK and explicit user approval.
boundaries.mcpA2a: Connections and outbound messages require ASK; secrets and safety bypasses are NEVER.
boundaries.controlLoop: The loop may plan and validate; only approved adapters may mutate state.
boundaries.infrastructure: CTXRoute routes context, Archify provides architecture evidence, and Sensor provides static safety diagnostics.
